C0521.title: Hacker Reverse-Engineered Software to Control 180,000 Cameras for Voyeurism, Profited 800,000 Yuan, Sentenced to 5 Years
C0521.summary: In April 2018, the defendant surnamed Wu used reverse-engineering software to obtain a database of usernames and passwords for a specific brand of cameras. He built an app to infiltrate and control over 180,000 cameras, charged membership fees to provide real-time surveillance footage, and earned more than RMB 800,000. The court sentenced him to five years in prison for illegally controlling computer information systems.
